title: The God of Hormuz
author: Elliot Sperber
content:
You is my friend  
I mean: Hugh is my friend  
But Hugh no longer understands

They lie so much  
to Hugh that Hugh  
Can no longer tell

What’s false or true

Nor does Hugh know much  
About the god Ahura Mazda

Hugh can’t see

That Ahura is shortened to Hur  
and Mazda’s truncated to Maz

Put em together  
And what’ve you got?

Hur maz, or Hor muz  
Like the Strait of Hormuz

You’ll get there faster  
With Zoroaster

The prophet

Who’s sick of Hugh

For tolerating lies

And Mazda, they say, means wise  
When really it’s closer to  
Placing the mind

And where will you place it?

What’ll you attend to, Hugh?  
What can you do?

Will Hugh deviate from fate?  
They say the weight  
May be too great

But weigh  
Can mean both burden  
And consideration  
Can Hugh even choose?

Will Hugh startle?  
Will Hugh start?  
Will you depart  
From the light to the dark  
Like a reflex?

Or will you reflect?  
Like a stone in the bed

In the bed of the stream  
Awake in the dream
